hypothesis: In mm/memory.c and mm/zswap.c / mm/swap_state.c, allowing high-order folios (orders 2 and 4) when all swap slots in the aligned cluster range reside in zswap enables assembling contiguous compressed swap slots into a single high-order folio during swap-in and installing with a single set_ptes() hold, eliminating repeated PTL acquisition and per-page fault overhead while preserving latency and memory stability. Reject if candidate causes data corruption, slot leakage in zswap, page table locking races, fails correctness gates, or fails calibrated screening.
reason: Authoring Hypothesis 4 proposal for batched high-order mTHP swap-in for zswap.

mechanism.claim: In mm/memory.c (thp_swapin_suitable_orders) and mm/zswap.c (zswap_load), when all swap slots in an aligned order-2 or order-4 range reside in zswap, thp_swapin_suitable_orders permits the high-order folio and zswap_load assembles contiguous compressed slots into the allocated high-order folio, installing them in do_swap_page with a single set_ptes() call under one page table lock hold.
mechanism.falsifier: Exact-tree review shows lost lifetime protection, incorrect slot conflict handling, or broken cache lookup fallback. Correctness, metadata spread <1%, and calibrated fast-tier screen independently gate execution.
